pairs.question: Numquid ergo illa quae restant non sunt ventura?
pairs.answer: Manifestum est quia sicut ista praedicta venerunt, sic etiam illa ventura sunt, quaecumque tribulationes justorum adhuc restant, et judicii dies, qui separabit omnes impios a justis in resurrectione mortuorum, et non solum eos qui sunt extra Ecclesiam, sed etiam ipsius Ecclesiae paleas, quas oportet usque ad novissimam ventilationem patientissime sufferat, ad ignem debitum segregabit.
pairs.derivation: Augustine poses a genuine interrogative (Numquid... non sunt ventura?) and answers it himself. Answer-window: kept the directly-answering first sentence (capitalized opening 'manifestum'); cut at the first full stop after 'ad ignem debitum segregabit.' What follows ('Qui autem irrident resurrectionem...') turns from answering whether the remaining things will come to elaborating on the resurrection of mockers and the faithful, so it is excluded. Section number '54' stripped as scaffolding; scripture-reference brackets did not fall within the quoted spans.
